sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith - HK MP5 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "New clients mean new weapon builds, and I've only got two hands... I'd also like to sleep every now and then. If you're looking to make some money, you could help me out. Right now I need an MP5 with a 50-round extended magazine, a suppressor, a tactical flashlight, and a sighting range above 200. Ergonomics at or above 45, combined recoil at or below 240, and a weight of no more than 4 kg. I'll provide the MP5. Everything else is up to you. Bring it back when it's ready."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify an MP5 to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.1
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Bundle of wires
- Unlocks barter for Glock 17 9x19 pistol (variant Tac 3) at Mechanic LL1
"Compact, quiet, and well-suited for close quarters... A solid build. The client will be pleased."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
MP5 specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 45 or greater ergonomics
- 240 or less recoil
- 200 or greater sighting range
- 4 kg or less in weight
- Any tactical device (such as the NcSTAR Tactical Blue Laser)
- A silencer
- HK MP5 9x19 X Products X-5 50-round drum magazine

sections.heading: Build
sections.text: This is one example of many possible configurations.

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard MP5 from Peacekeeper LL1.
- Don't forget to transfer the rear sight from the old receiver.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
